summary: Phase 2 backend testing complete — 36/36 new Phase 2 tests pass (1 intentionally skipped: ElevenLabs clone-missing-key path, can't unset env default). Covers ElevenLabs voice clone (settings, voices listing via real API, TTS speak), Photos (upload to Emergent object storage, list, file download via Bearer + ?auth=, patch, soft-delete, all edge cases — empty/oversize/bad-mime), and Companion (device registration, command queue, /poll dispatch with device_token, /result, multi-user isolation, voice empty-audio guard, /voice 401 on non-device-token, script download with token substitution + Content-Disposition, device revocation). Regression: /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard, /api/archive still healthy.

minor.issue: Cannot test missing-API-key 400 path because ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is hardcoded in .env as a default fallback — test skipped. Code review of the path looks correct (raises 400 when _resolve_key returns empty).
Real audio path not exercised (would burn Whisper+Claude credits and no audio sample in env). Guards (empty audio → 400, non-device-token → 401) both verified.
Returns 200 instead of 201 for creation (same cosmetic REST issue as iteration_1).

critical_code_review_comments: photos.py: upload validates MIME against an allowlist, enforces 12MB cap, generates safe storage path under user namespace `heirloom/photos//.`. Soft-delete via is_deleted flag, list query honors it. /file endpoint accepts both Bearer header and ?auth= query (needed for ). All Mongo reads use {"_id": 0}. Good.

companion.py: get_device_user dependency cleanly separates device-token auth from user-session auth. revoked devices correctly rejected with 401. /poll atomically flips status queued→dispatched. /result correctly scopes update by both cmd_id AND user_id (prevents cross-tenant tampering). Multi-user isolation verified explicitly in tests.

companion.py /voice: Whisper STT + Claude reply + action-line parsing + skill invocation are well separated. Robust to LLM failures (502s). Persists turns under a dedicated 'companion_twin' conversation kind — good.
companion.py /script: substitutes both DEVICE_TOKEN and BACKEND_URL_HINT into the template; Content-Disposition is correct; verifies device ownership before serving (404 on stranger tokens). Tested.

voice_clone.py: clean separation of settings (user override + .env default fallback), voices listing (real ElevenLabs API call works with bundled key — confirmed in test_voices_listing), and speak (streams audio chunks and returns base64). 400 guard when voice_id missing works.

Minor: voice_clone.py /clone uses files=samples (list of BytesIO) — emergent integrations expects this exact shape per SDK; could not verify without burning credits but signature matches AsyncElevenLabs.voices.ivc.create.
Minor: storage.py init_storage uses module-level cache + lock — thread-safe, but a 403 refresh inside put/get could race if multiple workers retry simultaneously. Acceptable for current scale.

Minor: companion script template embeds the device token in plaintext in the downloaded .py — by design (it IS a secret bearer token for that script), but the doc-comment correctly warns users it can be revoked.

Minor: photos.py /upload accepts Form fields (caption, taken_at) but does NOT validate taken_at format — accepts arbitrary strings like '1987' or 'last summer'. Probably intentional (flexible captions).

Minor: companion.py /voice happy path persists 'spoken_reply' (clean) but the message saved in conversations contains the raw reply_text WITH ::ACTION lines — slight UX inconsistency but the assistant-facing reply field is the cleaned one.
